RULES (DELETE THIS WHEN REMIXING AFTER READING)

1. Please don't add more than 10 characters per remix, we're trying to save on Scratch Project space.

2. You can add music, but please don't delete any. If any music becomes a 00:00 timed line of silence, make sure you've compressed it enough for scratch to safely load it repeatedly without deleting the file. This is to prevent silence in the songs.

3. DON'T DELETE OR MODIFY THE TEMPLATE SPRITE! Other users need it to add their characters.

4. Please do not mess up the project.

5. You're allowed to have MULTIPLE CHARACTERS in one Sprite to save up on space. (ex: AJAY, AJAYMAY, CORY and MAY as 1 character).

6. You're welcome to add the characters you added to the game into the thumbnail, but be careful as this will make the thumbnail appear crowded very much.

udK1y0-`DKf!zcUY+ZL9.text:
Before you submit your remix, make sure that you followed all of the rules:

1. Do not add more than 10 characters per remix.
2. You can add music, but do not delete any.
3. Do not modify or delete the Player0 sprite, other users need it to add their characters.
4. Please do not mess up the project.
5. Do not modify the hitboxes, everyone needs to have the same sized hitbox for a fair game. Changing the sprite size of your player is considered breaking this rule.
6. Do not make your character appear too large. That will make things hard to see.
7. Do not add a singular character that appears to be 2 characters (ex: Mario and Luigi as 1 character) unless they are genetically stuck together with no way to physically detach them.
8. You can add a character to the thumbnail, but don't do so if the thumbnail appears crowded.

Failure to follow the rules will likely result in an unofficial remix.
